create_movielens_dataset: create a MovieLens dataset builder with tfds to load ratings or movies data from GroupLens
build_movielens_config: build a MovieLensConfig specifying format version like 25m and table option like ratings or movies
test_movielens_info: test the Movielens _info method to retrieve dataset features and schema for a given builder config
run_movielens_splits: run the Movielens _split_generators to download and extract the dataset archive for training splits
summarize_movielens_examples: summarize the Movielens _generate_examples method to yield movie and rating records from parsed CSV files
